summary: Call a target with an explicit thisArgument and an array-like argument list using Reflect.apply semantics.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.this_binding: uses supplied thisArgument under ordinary JS call semantics
semantics.evaluation_order: target, thisArgument, argumentsList expressions are evaluated before the call

caveats: Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: array-like arguments
tests.expected_behavior: prints an array equivalent to [3,6]; a non-iterable array-like argumentsList is accepted
